The stock increased 0.16% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $48.7. About 7.81M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500.
Oracle Corporation develops, manufactures, markets, sells, hosts, and supports application, platform, and infrastructure technologies for information technology environments worldwide. The company has market cap of $184.51 billion. It provides services in three primary layers of the cloud: Software as a Service, Platform as a Service, and Infrastructure as a Service. It has a 51.37 P/E ratio. The firm licenses its Oracle Database software, which enables storage, retrieval, and manipulation of data; and Oracle Fusion Middleware software to build, deploy, secure, access, and integrate business applications, as well as automate their business processes.
